title: ServiceNow reports Q3 subscription revenue up 21% YoY to $3.99B, forecasts Q4 current remaining performance obligations below est.; NOW drops 15%+ after hours (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)
summary: Brody Ford / Bloomberg: ServiceNow reports Q3 subscription revenue up 21% YoY to $3.99B, forecasts Q4 current remaining performance obligations below est.; NOW drops 15%+ after hours — ServiceNow Inc. shares plunged after the company gave an outlook for quarterly subscription sales that met analysts' estimates …
